title: Will Ospreay vs. MJF: the International title
summary: MJF takes Ospreay’s championship before Ospreay pursues a return victory at Wembley.

chapters.title: MJF wins with seconds remaining
chapters.result: MJF defeats Ospreay for the International Championship.
chapters.context: The nearly hour-long match creates the stakes for their return meeting.

chapters.title: Ospreay regains the title
chapters.result: Ospreay defeats MJF to regain the championship.
chapters.context: The Wembley rematch reverses the result from Dynamite.
